description:
Cast Skycoach Conductor // All Aboard by tapping Archaeomancer due to Skycoach Conductor // All Aboard's convoke ability, blinking Archaeomancer.
When Archaeomancer enters, it triggers, returning Skycoach Conductor // All Aboard from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
